Open Source Architecture

Built for the Self-Hosted Community

Portal Heaven was built to solve the fragmentation of the IPTV ecosystem. Instead of relying on closed-source Android APKs or struggling with browser CORS restrictions, we built a robust middleware proxy.

The backend is a lightweight Node.js/Express server that acts as a secure bridge, translating proprietary Stalker API handshakes into standard JSON for the React frontend. It also rewrites HLS manifests on the fly, allowing you to bypass strict CORS blocks and stream smoothly on any device.

Zero-Knowledge Security

🔐

Client-Side AES-GCM

Your portal credentials and MAC addresses are encrypted directly in your browser using military-grade AES-GCM encryption before they are ever sent to the server.

🛡️

Cloudflare Turnstile

Invisible CAPTCHA protects against botnets, brute-force attacks, and credential stuffing.

🔑

Secure SSO Integration

Google/GitHub OAuth2 with HttpOnly JWT tokens, strict SameSite policies.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Portal Heaven provide any TV channels or movies?

No. Portal Heaven is strictly a media player and proxy tool. We do not host, distribute, or provide any content, streams, or IPTV subscriptions. You must provide your own legal content or possess a valid subscription to a third-party IPTV service.

What is a Stalker Portal?

A Stalker Portal (Ministra) is middleware used by IPTV providers. Portal Heaven emulates the hardware environment in your browser.

Why do I need a proxy to watch IPTV in my browser?

Browsers enforce CORS and Mixed Content policies. Our Node.js backend handles the handshake and rewrites manifests to bypass restrictions.

Can I install this on my Smart TV or iPhone?

Yes — as a PWA, open the URL in Safari/Chrome and tap “Add to Home Screen”. Works on Android TV, iOS, and desktop.

Is my MAC address and password safe?

Yes. Credentials are encrypted client-side with AES-GCM before syncing. Our server only stores encrypted ciphertext – we cannot read them.
